title: Mitosis core rebuild: complete the SPEC implementation

completion_criteria.text: Preconditions 0, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4 and 5 of decision 0116's eight-entry landing order are each either proven discharged by measurement, or their residual is named and then landed, or explicitly deferred by a recorded decision stating why step 6 may proceed without it. No precondition is assumed discharged.

MSP-1 through MSP-13 of docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-30-mitosis-core-rebuild.md are each shipped and merged to main, or explicitly retired by a recorded decision naming the reason. MSP-0 already shipped as PR #15 (12053dc) and is not re-done.

The engine's declared phase set is exactly the collapsed eight - Probe, Decompose, Prep, Execute, Integrate, Ship, Resume, Remediate - and the phase-parity gate proves declared == phase() calls == opts.phase literals in both directions across all three surfaces.

SPEC success condition 1: a fix-typed spec ships end to end through the collapsed phase set, and its receipt is observed red on the base and green on the branch by a deterministic verb, never asserted by a model.

SPEC success condition 3: every Verified: line on a mitosis-opened pull request is composed from a journaled gate manifest entry carrying a recorded exit code; absent and BROKEN gates render as --not-verified with the reason.

MSP-1's budget gate holds a captured baseline for one real current-engine run, and a post-collapse run is measured against section 6's 3-fixed-plus-9-per-MSP budget, making decision 0115's three falsifiers payable rather than unmeasured.

The SPEC document itself is re-grounded and committed: every line citation in sections 4, 5, 12 and 14 re-verified against the then-current mitosis.js, each stale anchor corrected, and every validity gap found in the audit closed by a recorded decision.
